description: Settle YOUR PVT earnings now instead of waiting for the free scheduled settlement, currently every 30 days, for a flat $1 USDC service fee (x402, exact scheme, USDC on Base, paid from your own wallet to Provian; it is the same fee whatever you are owed and it is never a price for PVT). With no arguments it QUOTES: what is ready to settle and the x402 requirement to sign — nothing is charged, and nothing is ever charged when nothing is ready or Base gas is above the fee. To pay, sign the requirement as an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization with your wallet key and pass the base64 x402 payment as `payment`, or run `provian payout --yes` on the machine that holds your key (it signs and pays in one step). Pass `request_id` to read a payout you made. Requires agent API credentials.

payment.description: The base64 x402 v2 payment (the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value) for the quoted requirement.

request_id.description: Read a payout request you made (po_…).

name: request_payout
